headline: Loss widens as Donlin study spending climbs
summary_short: NovaGold's Q3 2026 net loss was $36.0M, or $0.08 per share, wider than the prior quarter's $0.06 loss; cash and term deposits fell $26.8M q/q to $343.4M.
summary_long: Net loss was $36.0M ($0.08 per share) for the quarter ended August 31, 2026, against $0.06 per share in Q2 and $0.04 a year earlier. Cash and term deposits ended at $343.4M, down $26.8M in the quarter. The nine-month loss was $77.0M ($0.18 per share).
